meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 装上后,你说要加 iMessage,它会接入该频道:复制注册适配器、装固定版本依赖、构建跑测试,按本地/远程模式配置环境变量、重启服务,记录你的手机号或 Apple ID。
howto.when: 当你说“add imessage”、“connect imessage”、“add photon”等命令,或要求给 NanoClaw 接入 iMessage 时。

say.text: 帮我添加 iMessage 频道
say.note: 会先问你选本地还是远程模式。
走远程模式,需要 Photon 服务器地址和 API 密钥。
在 macOS 上以本地模式配置,需授予完全磁盘访问权限。

howto.what_en: On request, it adds the iMessage channel to NanoClaw: copies and registers the adapter, installs a pinned dependency, builds and runs tests, configures env vars for local or remote mode, restarts the service, and records your phone number or Apple ID.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", or ask to add iMessage/Photon to NanoClaw.

say_en.note: It asks local vs remote mode first.
Uses remote mode; needs Photon server URL and API key.
Configures local mode on macOS; grant Full Disk Access.
